notes: Reached by plain direct HTTPS fetch (route 1); no WAF, no proxy needed. Category tree taken from https://www.dunelm.com/sitemap/category-sitemap.xml (650 URLs) cross-checked against the mega-menu JSON in the page's own ssr-state-data (reduxState.editorialContent.content.nav). Dunelm A/B-serves two PLP templates; both were parsed. Counts are the rendered listing header 'N results', which on the newer template is identical to "totalProducts":N inside the <script id="shell-ssr-data"> dehydrated react-query state - the two agreed on every category where both were present, so the structured total passes. Exhaustion-verified on 5 categories (Mirrors 733: page 12 'viewed 720 of 733', page 13 = 13 tiles, page 14 = 404; Clocks, Glassware, Wall Art, Curtain Tiebacks all had last-page tile counts equal to total-(pages-1)*60 with the next page 404). Ceiling Lights' last page returned 34 tiles vs 27 expected (sponsored/PLA tiles injected into the grid but excluded from the total); "totalPages":15=ceil(871/60) and page 16 = 404, so the header stands. Every one of the 29 leaf counts was re-fetched live at the end of the run and 28 reproduced exactly; only Ceiling Lights drifted (867 -> 872 -> 871) and is flagged. Hub pages (/home-decor, /lighting, /dining-and-tableware, /wall-art-and-decor, /home-fragrance) render no product grid and are emitted as parent rows only. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED - subsets/re-cuts proven by filter counts, not names: Chandeliers (55; ceiling-lights?product-type=chandeliers = 51, i.e. 93% inside Ceiling Lights), Tripod Lights (14; 13 inside Floor Lamps), Outdoor Lighting (300; 174 inside Wall Lights + 16 inside Ceiling Lights), Bathroom Lights (175; page-1 products carry primaryCategory Ceiling_Lights/Wall_Lights), LED Lights (597, feature re-cut), Quirky Lighting (279, style re-cut - page-1 primaryCategory is Table_Lamps/Floor_Lamps). Shop-all roll-ups dropped: All Home Decor (8656), All Gallery (3192), All Lighting (2853), All Dining (2062). OUT OF SCOPE per brief: Home Fragrance incl. Candles (346 - fragrance facet shows only 46 Unscented, i.e. 87% scented, and there is no unscented child category, only a filter) and Diffusers; artificial/dried flowers and plants; Light Bulbs (148); Cutlery (128) and Cafetieres (92); Barware (130 - page-1 titles are cocktail shakers, ice buckets, jiggers and stoppers, i.e. bar tools); Napkins & Napkin Rings (66 - page-1 titles are cotton/linen napkins = table linens); Placemats & Coasters (227 - table protection/linens); Wine Racks (5, storage); Notice Boards (22) and Doorstops (39) (functional); Wall & Door Hooks (51, mixed functional over-door hooks); Curtain Rings & Fixtures (155, hardware); Garden Decoration (533, outdoor garden ornaments/water features); Christmas and Gifts; all textiles (cushions, curtains, blinds, bedding, throws, rugs), furniture, bathroom, electricals, cleaning and DIY/wallpaper. ADDENDUM (Rule 0 top-up, 2026-08-10): re-visited the site's mega-menu (Lighting and Bathroom department nav), category-sitemap.xml, and the Mirrors category's own room facet to find every room-based lighting/mirror branch not already captured. Added 3 rows, all with live-verified exact counts (rendered header + totalProducts JSON, cross-checked with a last-page/next-page-404 exhaustion check, and re-read a second time to rule out session drift -- none of the three drifted, unlike Ceiling Lights which is known to drift within a session): Bathroom Lighting (175): Rule-0 top-up: dedicated nav node (Lighting > Bathroom Lighting, https://www.dunelm.com/category/lighting/bathroom-lights) present in mega-menu and category-sitemap.xml. Original pass excluded this as a room-word re-cut of Ceiling/Wall Lights; Rule 0.6 requires emitting the room branch alongside the type branches with overlap noted (page-1 products carry primaryCategory Ceiling_Lights/Wall_Lights, i.e. it is a genuine second nav branch over the same underlying lighting inventory, not a duplicate URL). | Outdoor Lighting (300): Rule-0 top-up: dedicated nav node (Lighting > Outdoor Lighting, https://www.dunelm.com/category/lighting/outdoor-lighting) present in mega-menu and category-sitemap.xml. Original pass excluded this as a room-word re-cut (174 inside Wall Lights + 16 inside Ceiling Lights by facet count, i.e. only ~63% overlap); Rule 0.6 requires emitting outdoor lighting as its own row regardless of overlap with the type tree. | Bathroom Mirrors (53): Rule-0 top-up: dedicated nav node under the Bath department (Bathroom > Bathroom Mirrors, https://www.dunelm.com/category/home-and-furniture/bathroom/bathroom-mirrors), confirmed linked in that department's own nav menu and in category-sitemap.xml -- a genuine second nav branch, not an orphan URL. Partial overlap only: filtering the general Mirrors category by room=bathroom (https://www.dunelm.com/category/home-decor/mirrors?room=bathroom) returns 34 of 733, so at least 19 of these 53 (title 'Bathroom Mirrors - Shaving & With Lights') are not reachable from the general Mirrors listing at all. Per Rule 0.6, emitted as its own row with overlap documented. (Note: 'Outdoor Mirrors' is NOT added -- it exists only as a facet badge/filter on the general Mirrors page, product-type style re-cut, no dedicated URL of its own, so it stays excluded per Rule 0.6's facet exception.) Checked and confirmed NOT missing anything else: no dedicated Vanity/Kitchen/Recessed/Track/Under-cabinet lighting category pages exist anywhere in category-sitemap.xml (Kitchen lights and Cabinet lighting on the site are filter facets only, e.g. all-lighting?room=kitchen and all-lighting?product-type=cabinet-lights, not their own nav nodes, so they stay excluded as facet re-cuts per Rule 0.6); Outdoor Mirrors is likewise a facet badge on the general Mirrors page with no dedicated URL, so it stays excluded. All previously-existing rows and the original notes text were left untouched.
